$comment: North Star indicator input, schema_version 1. A repository that feeds an objective publishes this as the release asset `north-star-input.json`, listed in the release's cosign-signed SHA256SUMS. pulseengine.eu's monthly north-star workflow reads the latest release of each product named in data/north-star.toml. A missing, unsigned or invalid file is not counted (never zero-filled); a fact with ran=false counts as failed. A change to this shape is a new schema_version, announced on the seam issue first.

id.description: stable id, e.g. a ladder rung (O1: '<target>/<rung>'), a gate name (O5) or a proof check (O3)

ran.description: false = not run this release; counts as a fail

control_failed_as_expected.description: the planted negative control for this fact turned it red

detail.description: objective-specific fields (O1: target, rung, oracle; O3: proof_check_required, axiom_audit, ledger; O5: signed, kiln_runs, wasmtime_equal, equivalence_in_ci, gap_switch)

evidence.description: URL of the run or artifact that shows it

not_measured.description: what this input is blind to, stated by the producer
